title: Envelope
description: The wire format of every outbox message (DOC-09 §3). `payload` is validated by the schema named in `type`.

id.description: UUIDv7 of the outbox row; the inbox key together with the handler name.

source.description: The producing module; equals the first segment of `type`.

aggregateId.description: Ordering and grouping key (the field named in the catalog).

occurredAt.description: When the state change was written.

correlationId.description: The request id that started the chain.

causationId.description: The request id or message id that caused this message.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context. Absent in phase 1: no traces are built (DR-63).
